title: Batched VJP for a dense multi-output Jacobian objective
authoring_note: Baseline wraps a tiny MLP in torch.compile and injects an .item()-dependent graph break; the measurement loop cycles 8 batch sizes, causing repeated recompilation. Oracle removes the graph break and compiles with dynamic=True. Scope is intentionally small so warmup fits the time budget on CPU-only CI.
author: batch-C prototype agent
